verdict.rationale: CoreWeave provides S3-compatible object storage for training data/checkpoints/model weights (open, portable format) and Terraform/OpenTofu for infra-as-code, plus a FOCUS API for exporting billing data, which supports data portability rather than lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation of a comprehensive 'export all my data' workflow or account-closure/migration tooling covering all CoreWeave services (compute, inference, storage) in one open format. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/account-level data export or migration guide, confirmation that all data types (not just object storage) are exportable in open formats, and any independent/hands-on evidence of users successfully exporting and leaving.
